title: Literal parser round trip
statement: For every literal $\ell$ over natural-number variable indices and every bit string $r$, parsing the encoding of $\ell$ followed by $r$ returns the literal $\ell$ together with the remainder $r$.
replaced:
For every literal $\ell$ and remainder word $r$, the literal parser applied to the
serialization of $\ell$ followed by $r$ succeeds and returns exactly $(\ell, r)$.
